objective.primary_metric: scheduled-day mean after 40 bp round-trip cost

expert_library.rule: Use every preregistered architecture expert, including the price-core control. Do not remove an expert based on its realized full-period performance.
expert_library.daily_expert_return: Equal-weight two-slot open-to-close return; an unobserved slot is cash; subtract 40 bp only from observed slots.

hypotheses.definition: For each expert, compute an EWMA of clipped daily net40 returns using only completed prior dates, half-life 20 sessions. Convert the prior EWMA values to softmax weights with temperature 0.50 percentage points. Give each expert's rank 1 candidate one full weighted vote and rank 2 candidate one half weighted vote; sum votes by code and display the two largest.
hypotheses.initial_state: All experts have EWMA value zero and equal softmax weight.
hypotheses.prediction: Online evidence pooling adapts to model drift without selecting one full-sample winner.

hypotheses.definition: Use equal expert weights every date with the same rank-1/full and rank-2/half voting rule.
hypotheses.prediction: Diversification alone, without outcome feedback, may stabilize the daily top two.

hypotheses.definition: Use the two candidates of the single expert with the largest strictly-prior 20-session EWMA net40; ties resolve by expert id.
hypotheses.initial_state: Use C00_daily_rank_ridge until one completed score date is available.
hypotheses.prediction: A hard online regime switch may adapt faster than convex voting.

point_in_time.target_day_mutation_test: Replace each target day's returns after candidate selection and require candidate keys to remain exact.
